## Description and Rationale

I am a data science and machine learning enthusiast with an interest in aviation and real-world predictive modeling. I joined the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to apply machine learning to the problem of taxi-out time prediction, explore large-scale flight data, and develop a robust and reproducible solution. I am also excited about the challenge's focus on open science and sharing solutions with the broader aviation community.
